relationships.subject: CCL2
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings demonstrate that EA suppresses spinal CCL2-driven microglial activation to produce its analgesic effects in neuropathic pain.

key_findings: Electroacupuncture at ST36/GB34 reduced spinal CCL2, CCR2, Iba1, IL-1β and TNF-α in SNL rats.
Intrathecal recombinant CCL2 abolished EA analgesia, indicating CCL2/CCR2 necessity.
